items.title: Bubble chamber bloom
items.description: Concentric layers reveal the delicate membrane-like quality of mathematical structures. The iridescent colors encode parameter angles, transforming abstract mathematics into visual language.

items.title: Polynomial roots mandala
items.description: Dense regions alternate with voids in the complex plane. The warm palette and organic boundaries emerge from millions of computed polynomial roots, revealing hidden mathematical symmetries.

items.title: Spectral braid
items.description: Flowing ribbons interweave in patterns that echo topological braids. Each strand represents a trajectory of polynomial roots as parameters vary continuously on the unit circle.

items.title: Translucent memoir
items.description: Delicate curves on a light background create an ethereal composition. The minimalist aesthetic allows the pure mathematical structure to speak without distraction.
